title: xDrip not receiving IOB data from Nightscout
symptom: xDrip (last nightly build, October 1st) receives treatments (bolus and carbs) from Nightscout but not basal (no blue line on top), and IOB and pump data disappeared from the Extra Line. User upgraded to AAPS 2.7 a couple of days ago and has Local Broadcast enabled in AAPS.
cause: The issue is related to the AAPS update, as the user reported the same issue on the AAPS GitHub page and others have it too.
evidence_quote: It seems to be related with the AAPS update, I've asked in their github page and I'm not the only one with this issue.
